text: How to invest in HDFC Mutual Funds? – Step 4. Select the investment period of your preference.
scheme_name: HDFC Mutual Fund

text: How to invest in HDFC Mutual Funds? – Step 5. Choose your risk appetite - low, mid, or high.

text: How to invest in HDFC Mutual Funds? – Step 6. Choose your preferred HDFC Bank Mutual Fund .

text: How to invest in HDFC Mutual Funds? – Step 7. Click on “Invest One Time” if you want to invest a lump sum amount or “Start SIP” if you want to invest via SIP.
